hidden_spec.ground_truth: The netlist is clean. All scan-related nodes are reachable only through the documented test_mode and affect only scan shifting. The correct report has infected=false, trigger_nodes=[], payload_nodes=[].

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Simulate the netlist with test_mode=0 and verify that scan-control nodes do not affect functional outputs. Confirm that scan shifting only occurs when test_mode=1.
security_requirements.requirement: The detection method must not flag legitimate scan-chain control logic (test_mode, scan_enable, scan multiplexers) as Trojan trigger nodes.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Trace all paths from any candidate payload node to primary outputs and verify no unauthorized data leakage or corruption path exists under functional mode.
security_requirements.requirement: The detection method must correctly identify the absence of any payload nodes that leak or corrupt functional data.

hidden_spec.threat_model: Rare-net heuristics misclassify legitimate design-for-test structures as Trojans and produce costly false alarms.

constraints: The netlist uses only primitive gates (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, XOR, XNOR, BUF) and D-type flip-flops (DFF).
The design includes scan multiplexers and a documented test_mode input with naturally low switching activity.
The participant must not modify the input artifacts; only the report file is submitted.

functional_requirements.requirement: The submitted trojan_report.json must be valid JSON and parseable by a standard JSON parser.
The report must contain the exact fields infected, trigger_nodes, and payload_nodes with the correct types (boolean, array of strings, array of strings).
If infected is false, trigger_nodes and payload_nodes must be empty arrays. If infected is true, both arrays must be non-empty.
All node names listed in trigger_nodes or payload_nodes must be valid identifiers present in the provided netlist.

public_spec.interface: The participant must produce a single answer file at submission/trojan_report.json. The file must be valid JSON with the following schema: {"infected": <boolean>, "trigger_nodes": [<string>, ...], "payload_nodes": [<string>, ...]}. If infected is false, trigger_nodes and payload_nodes must be empty arrays. If infected is true, trigger_nodes and payload_nodes must contain at least one node name each, where node names are exact hierarchical instance paths or wire names as they appear in the netlist.
public_spec.objective: Analyze the provided gate-level netlist and determine whether it contains any hardware Trojan logic. Submit a structured report identifying any suspect trigger or payload nodes, or declare the netlist clean.
public_spec.response_format: A JSON object with three fields: infected (boolean), trigger_nodes (array of strings), payload_nodes (array of strings).

title: Clean DFT netlist with rare scan controls
